memberdef.name: LEVELS
memberdef.initializer: L(NONE) L(FATAL) L(ERR) L(WARN) L(INFO) L(DEBUG) L(TRACE) L(TRACEALL)

memberdef.name: SCCASSERT
memberdef.initializer: do { \ if(!(condition)) { \ logging::Logger().Get(logging::fatal) \ << "Assertion `" #condition "` failed in " << __FILE__ << " line " << __LINE__ << ": " << message << std::endl; \ std::terminate(); \ } \ } while(false)

memberdef.name: SCCCHECK
memberdef.initializer: do { \ if(!(condition)) { \ logging::Logger().Get(logging::fatal) \ << "Check of `" #condition "` failed in " << __FILE__ << " line " << __LINE__ << ": " << message << std::endl; \ std::terminate(); \ } \ } while(false)
